subject: Geopolitics
title: Venezuela's Oil Collapse
description: A quick, practical guide to Venezuela's Oil Collapse.

hook.text: Venezuela holds the world's largest oil reserves. Its people eat from garbage bins. Resource wealth became a curse.

buildup.text: Chávez used oil revenue to fund social programs and buy loyalty. When prices fell, the system had no backup plan.

discovery.text: Mismanagement gutted PDVSA, the state oil company. Production crashed from 3.3 million to 700,000 barrels daily.

twist.text: Despite having more oil than Saudi Arabia, Venezuela cannot produce enough to feed its people. Infrastructure rotted.

climax.text: Venezuela is the ultimate cautionary tale: oil wealth without governance destroys nations from within.

punchline.text: The most oil on Earth. The worst economy in the hemisphere.

quiz.question: Why did Venezuela's oil wealth fail to prevent collapse?
options: Other nations stole Venezuela's oil reserves
Mismanagement and lack of investment gutted production
Venezuela's oil quality was too poor to sell
